description: Send one plain-text message to every live Claude Code and Codex session except yourself, each routed separately by its own state and budgets. It is for announcements, so it is never urgent: fyi (the default) is batched until each session is idle, normal reaches a session at its next tool call unless it was interrupted a lot lately. To reach one session or a group, use send_message or a channel instead.

message.description: The message text. Plain text; include file paths rather than file contents.

urgency.description: fyi: batched until each session is idle. normal: delivered at each session's next tool call unless it was interrupted a lot lately.

name: broadcast
title: Message every live session
